purpose: Teach: 書き込ま/予告編/エンターテインメント/ニックネーム/イコール/号機/点灯/アース
target_vocab: エンターテインメント

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員に重要事項を書き込ませた
lines.en: When the company was starting out, Father had the staff write down the important principles.
lines.style: Quiet, measured tempo. Gentle weight on each memory. Slight pause between phrases like a man sorting through decades. Warm but unsentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新製品の予告編広告を出された
lines.en: Yes. Father launched a teaser advertisement for the new product himself.
lines.style: Confirmation with gentle affirmation. Nod in the voice. Steady pace, grounded in admiration. Slight softening on the verb — not reporting, remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員旅行にエンターテインメントを企画された
lines.en: Father planned entertainment for the staff trip. Made it memorable for everyone.
lines.style: Softer now, almost nostalgic. Slower pace on the second sentence. Eyes distant — not looking at the listener but at the memory. Breath a little heavier.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員にニックネームを付けて親しまれた
lines.en: Yes. Father gave all the staff nicknames — they were close because of it.
lines.style: Tender acknowledgment. Slight smile beneath the words. Pace steady but unhurried. Delicate touch on 'nicknames' — not mocking, human. His voice holds quiet pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、価格と品質はイコールではないと社員に教えた
lines.en: Father taught the staff that price and quality aren't the same thing. That lesson stayed with them.
lines.style: Deliberate delivery. Slight emphasis on the principle itself — this was a teaching moment. Pace measured. Slight exhale after the principle, like releasing something important.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは初号機の試運転に立ち会われた
lines.en: Yes. Father was there for the trial run of the first unit. Witnessed it himself.
lines.style: Quieter warmth. Slower than before. Settling into the weight of that moment. Pride underneath, not proclaimed. Breath steady and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、看板の点灯式に出席された
lines.en: Father attended the sign lighting ceremony. That was an important day.
lines.style: Almost dreamlike now. Softest pace yet. Each word carries the weight of a milestone. Trailing slightly at the end — a man letting a memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは電気のアース処理に詳しかった
lines.en: Yes. Father had real knowledge of electrical grounding — the technical details mattered to him.
lines.style: Final affirmation, quieter than the others. Gentle closure. Slight wonder in the voice — appreciating the breadth of the man's care. Exhale at the end, like lowering something precious.
